notes.title: Audio Hotfix 06/19/2025
notes.content:
The tormentor QTE volume has been decreased by default.

An issue where the SFX slider would not adjust the Tormentor volume has been resolved.
Thanks to RogerPlays for brining this issue to my attention.

Audio volume adjustments have been made in many aspects of the game. It should be more balanced now with less volume spikes. 

Some minor bug fixes.

Thank you for your feedback!

notes.title: HotFix 06/10/2025
notes.content:
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[olist]
[*]Fixed an issue with the Tormentor Quick Time Event not displaying on certain resolutions.
[*] Fixed an issue where the camera would lose focus when exiting interactions abruptly.
[*]Performance improvements
[/olist]

[h3]Changes[/h3]
[olist]
[*]Tormentor's health is now dynamic, it adjusts based on Ophelia's insanity levels. The higher Ophelia's insanity, the larger their health pool. Manage your Olanzapine accordingly.
[*] New death animation for Ophelia when she "dies" from a Tormentor.
[/olist]

notes.title: Major Update 05/26/2025
notes.content:
Some major changes made their way into the game with today's patch.
The combat system has been completely revamped.

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[olist]
[*]Zombie Enemies removed from the game entirely.
[*]Combat system has [b]changed completely[/b] into a reactive & timing based type of combat that fits the narrative of the game much better. 
[*]Ophelia's Tormentor has been introduced as the main enemy. Extremely hard to kill with regular means.
[*] Box cutter is now useless in combat, it remains as one of the "bad" items for it's alternative purpose.
[*]Additional Regenol (Health Item) have been added to the game.
[*] The amount of Health Regenol restores has been increased slightly.
[*] Ophelia's footstep sounds volume has been decreased.
[*] Various sound volume adjustments that should improve the overall experience.
[*] Enemy spawn points have been slightly changed and randomized. The encounters should feel more random now.
[/olist]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[olist]
[*]Fixed a bug at the Lobotomy Machine that caused the controls to get stuck if you used ESC to end the interaction.
[*]Fixed a bug that only happened for some users that did not restore Ophelia's uninjured state after using Regenol.
[*]Fixed a visual bug that Regenol (health item) did not properly update the user interface.
[*]Fixed the issue of visibility for some text documents being too bright when flashlight was on.
[*]Fixed a bug at the sacrificial table that exiting the interaction by pressing ESC too soon would cause the axe to get stuck on Ophelia's hand along with any other equipped weapon.
[*]Fixed an issue with Saint Seraphine's tablet that would not stop inspecting it when pressing ESC.
[/olist]

[img]https://finalfallgame.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/battletest.gif[/img]

As always i am grateful for the feedback. I hope those changes will improve your experience with Final Fall.

notes.title: Game Changes based on feedback - 05/16/2025
notes.content:
I take your feedback very seriously, and you will see that reflected in patches/changes as the game progresses. Today we have quite a few things changing.

[olist]
[*] Removed starting "Dazed" Animation. You can now walk normally and sprint from the beginning.
[*] Shower sequence removed entirely from the game.
[*] Clothes have been moved to a much closer and clear location. This should eliminate wandering around for those that didn't pay attention.
[*] Resistance Indicator has been added to the hallucinator resistance events. You can now see how fast you need to mash LMB during those events.
[*] Fixed a bug after yesterday's patch where the item outline would not be visible on items for certain users.
[*] More lighting changes and adjustments.
[*] Brightness slider Max value increased. 
[/olist]

I hope today's patch improves your experience with Final Fall. Thank you everyone for your feedback.

notes.title: 05/15/2025 - Minor Patch
notes.content:
I've heard you, you are afraid of the dark.

[olist]
[*] Brightness slider has been added in the options.
[*] Minor backend fixes.
[/olist]

Thank you for your feedback!

notes.title: HotFix 05/14/2025
notes.content:
A massive thank you to everyone that submitted their invaluable feedback.

[olist]
[*] Adjusted walking speed animation on the starting sequence.
[*]Adjusted the "stun" duration and animation speed when hitting a wall with the box cutter.
[*] Decreased the amount of damage enemies deal during a grab.
[*] Fixed a bug with the wheelchair puzzle.
[*] Optimizations for lower end CPUs.
[*] Overall lighting intensity slightly increased.
[*] Flashlight radius and intensity increased.
[*] Some UI text corrections.
[/olist]
